chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Jameel ibn Salih, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The most perfect of the believers in faith is the best of them in character.
ai.seo_question: What is the sign of perfect faith in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia scholarship, this hadith from al-Kafi is foundational to the concept of 'Akhlaq' as the outward manifestation of 'Iman', emphasizing that spiritual perfection is incomplete without ethical excellence. It reflects the Imams' teaching that moral character serves as the practical test of one's faith, linking inner belief directly to social conduct. This principle underscores the holistic nature of Shia spirituality, where ritual piety and interpersonal kindness are inseparable.
